---
title: "Spike B: own row mask"
format: html
---

```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(plotly)
library(DT)
source("common.R")
source("rowmask.R")

group <- "cars"
keys  <- rownames(mtcars)

filters <- list(
  cyl  = list(input = "radio",    label = "Cylinders"),
  gear = list(input = "dropdown", label = "Gears"),
  am   = list(input = "radio",    label = "Transmission", default = "1")
)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
htmltools::tagList(
  spike_dep("qr-spike-rowmask", "rowmask.js"),
  spike_filters(mtcars, group, keys, filters)
)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
mask_plotly(plot_ly(mtcars, x = ~mpg, y = ~hp, color = ~factor(cyl), type = "scatter", mode = "markers"), group)
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
mask_dt(datatable(mtcars[, c("mpg", "cyl", "disp", "hp", "wt", "gear", "am")]), group)
```
